_comment: Hand-labelled hard cases for the stance classifier. `expected` is the
outlet's stance toward Kosovo, NOT whether the news is good or bad.
Most of these are real headlines pulled from tone-article-cache.json on
2026-08-09, and most of them were labelled WRONG by the old pipeline —
`was` records what it said, so a regression is obvious.
`must_not_be` is the hard assertion: a case may be arguable between
neutral and positive, but calling a neutral wire report hostile is the
specific defect this suite exists to catch.
